title: Refactor UI Navigation Breadcrumb and Panel Toggles Into Elements
description: Move navigation breadcrumb and panel toggles from sketchpad into the UI component in semio-elements/ui. Every UI has navigation breadcrumbs and left/right panel toggles in the navbar. Refactor cleanly so sketchpad uses the generic UI component for these.
summary: Refactored UI component: navbar has breadcrumb and panel toggles. Added UIPanelVisibility, UIPanelToggles, useUI exposes panelVisibility/togglePanel.
